story.summary: Add a product to cart successfully
story.description:
*As a* shopper

*I want to* add a product from the inventory page to my cart

*So that* I can purchase it later. Based on the inventory page showing products such as "Sauce Labs Backpack", "Bike Light", and others. [Swag Labs|https://www.saucedemo.com/inventory.html]
h1. Acceptance Criteria
 # User can view available products on the inventory page. [Swag Labs|https://www.saucedemo.com/inventory.html]
 # User can click *Add to Cart* for a product.
 # Cart badge count increases by 1.
 # Selected product appears in the cart.
 # Product name and price match inventory details.
 # User can remove the product from the cart.
 # Cart badge updates accordingly.
